recommendations: Generate readable HTML for every route; meaningful page titles and unique descriptions.
Use one H1 per page, descriptive H2 headings, internal course/intake links, breadcrumb navigation, informative image alt text.
Provide canonical URLs using the actual deployment domain; never hardcode an unconfirmed domain.
Generate XML sitemap for canonical public content; robots.txt allows public content and references sitemap.
Noindex WhatsApp message-review state containing personal form data; use session storage, not personal query strings.
Return real HTTP 404 for missing URLs; do not map all unknown paths to home with status 200.
Archive historical intakes with past-status labels and links to current intakes; no active stale registration claims.
Use Organization/EducationalOrganization, WebSite and BreadcrumbList schema matching visible facts; Course semantics can describe actual courses but no rich-result promise.
Do not fabricate aggregate ratings, testimonials, award credentials, office address or opening hours.
Use visible FAQs to answer real questions; do not promise FAQ rich-result display.
After live deployment submit sitemap and verify Search Console; monitor real queries and revise keywords using measured data.

aiSearch.summary: Google says ordinary SEO fundamentals apply to AI search. Crawlability, textual information, internal links and structured data consistent with visible content matter. No special AI file/schema is required and inclusion is not guaranteed.
aiSearch.implementation: Place concise direct answers near relevant course facts. Maintain dates and authoritative identity. llms.txt may be an optional navigation aid, not a ranking or citation guarantee.

cloudflare.implementation: Cloudflare serves clean paths from generated HTML or folder index files. drop-trailing-slash canonicalizes both .html and trailing slash variants. Include top-level 404.html. Static assets can deploy directly using Wrangler without server logic.

contentGuardrails: User-confirmed upcoming Gred 1 is 19-22 December 2026; Gred 2 is 26-29 December 2026; each four days.
Both at IKBN Paloh Hinai, Pekan, Pahang; RM3,600 HRD Corp claimable and RM3,400 self pay.
PLKK 10 August 2026 is historical. Never reuse its free tuition/allowance/age/B40 benefits on December paid courses.
Other five course fields depend on funding grants and must not appear permanently open.
Provide either WhatsApp or Google Form; no automatic dual submission and no false sent-success state.
Current Google Form coverage is unverified. Retain client supplied link but document prelaunch verification requirement.
UCA course certificate is distinct from JKKP competency registration. Never imply course attendance alone grants competent-person status.
Use supplied poster eligibility rather than importing older competitor requirements. Link to JKKP for official application requirements.

suggestedFAQs.q: Di manakah kursus boiler UCA dijalankan?
suggestedFAQs.a: Pengambilan Disember 2026 dijalankan di IKBN Paloh Hinai, Pekan, Pahang.
Yuran yang dipaparkan untuk kedua-dua pengambilan Disember 2026 ialah RM3,600 bagi HRD Corp claimable atau RM3,400 bagi self pay.

suggestedFAQs.q: Bilakah pengambilan Boiler Gred 1 dan Gred 2?
suggestedFAQs.a: Gred 1 dijadualkan pada 19–22 Disember 2026. Gred 2 dijadualkan pada 26–29 Disember 2026. Setiap kursus berlangsung empat hari.
Pilih sama ada borang laman web untuk diteruskan ke WhatsApp atau Google Form. Untuk WhatsApp, semak mesej dan tekan Send dalam WhatsApp.

suggestedFAQs.q: Adakah sijil kursus sama dengan kelayakan kompetensi?
suggestedFAQs.a: Sijil kursus dan kelayakan kompetensi adalah berbeza. UCA mengeluarkan sijil penyertaan kursus; sijil sampingan ADTEC dan IKBN mengikut program. Hubungi UCA untuk maklumat sijil dan langkah seterusnya.
